metadata.description: We give a five-word real Pauli–Clifford normal form for an explicit 16 by 16 unitary Yang–Baxter operator in the exceptional Hecke class [exp(i pi/3), 1/2, 4]. Scalar partial traces yield the Markov trace and a faithful localization of the H_n(3,6) Jones–Wenzl tower; a direct obstruction proves that four is the minimum local dimension. C. Galindo and E. C. Rowell, Unitary Yang–Baxter Operators: Towards a Classification, arXiv:2608.16865v1, independently obtained the same existence and strict-localization conclusion, with four smallest in Lechner's exceptional family, through a quaternionic twisted-group-algebra construction. This revision gives an intrinsic quaternionic factorization and an exact local-unitary comparison to the opposite of their literal Family III operator, then extends the comparison to an all-strand unitary equivalence. It derives a scalar Turaev enhancement whose trace invariant is twice the HOMFLYPT specialization at (i,i), with finite-image, Clifford-frame, branched-cover, and exact polynomial-time consequences. The record includes the manuscript, five exact verification routes, deliberate failure tests, frozen output, checksums, source audits, chronology, and submission metadata.
